_comment: Pod to CPU core pinning configuration
_format: Each entry specifies pod_name, node (VM IP), and cores to pin to

taskmanagers._comment: TM-2 on node1, pinned to cores 0-3
TM-3 on node1, pinned to cores 4-7
TM-4 on node2, pinned to cores 0-3
TM-5 on node2, pinned to cores 4-7

_instructions: 1. Get your TaskManager pod names: kubectl get pods -l component=taskmanager -o wide
2. Note which node each pod runs on (NODE column)
3. Check available CPU cores on each node: ssh <node> lscpu
4. Assign non-overlapping core sets to pods on the same node
5. Use this file path in experiment config: pinning.mapping_file
Note: cores will be monitored per TM during the experiment
